logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Two-panel verification illustration for WO-04. Left: gate-check table listing each candidate with measured quality index, raw defect count, and gate verdict under the client policy (quality at least 80, defects at most 5); all four show PASS. Right: horizontal bar chart of measured energy per acceptance batch on a 0-70 kWh axis, bars proportional to 6 (P1), 14 (P3), 40 (P2), 67 (P4) kWh, with leader-gap labels +8, +34 and +61 kWh and a dashed leader reference line at P1's 6 kWh. Bottom callout box states the one correction found during verification: A's robustness claim that a quality gate of 95 removes only P2 is wrong - P3 (89) also fails, so P2 and P3 are removed and P1 (98), P4 (100) survive, with P1 still leading at 6 kWh. Footnote records that severity, cost, delivery and reliability data are unverified and excluded from ranking. Plain sans-serif typography, muted blue-green palette, no decorative elements.
